gates.action: Open teacher-review.html, review every item, record relevant qualification and app checks, export your private review. Correct rejected items before final approval.
Complete tests on the exact signed candidate and agreed device/OS scope; retain actual device model, OS, APK hash, expected/actual result.
Check screen-reader focus/labels, keyboard-only use, large text, contrast, touch targets and all success/error/PIN/purchase states on physical devices.

Complete physical network outage/recovery, foreground/restart/reboot, expiry, cancellation/refund and live-store candidate checks. Use sandbox only until live testing is separately arranged; do not make an unapproved paid transaction.
Review privacy-production-draft.json and resolve its publisher decisions, complete the risk assessment, then approve the exact final notice/declarations.
Search exact/similar names and logo use in each launch territory; retain dated search results/classes and review ownership/licences of art/fonts. A search alone is not a clearance guarantee.

Run tools/backup_signing.py interactively to create an encrypted backup outside Git, verify it, and store it off this computer with the passphrase separately. Confirm a recovery test and candidate certificate/hash.

Review UK English and each saved Amazon text/image profile with competent speakers. Check meaning, spelling, layout, English-only disclosures and development/purchase limitations. Arabic/Hindi have no Amazon profile; Dutch/Polish/European Portuguese have text but default image fallback.

rules: These are the repository release gates; they do not imply Amazon requires a teacher certificate. Amazon independently assesses its own policies.
Do not send private keys, passphrases, child records or private reviewer evidence to GitHub. Completed reviews should be kept outside the checkout.
No checkbox in this kit changes release/evidence.json, the content pack or Amazon. Hash-bound evidence must be recorded after actual review.
